name: reqseq-weight-and-balance
description: Weight and Balance demo for an invented aircraft. Not for flight operations.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json
scripts.lint:core: cd core && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked --no-deps --document-private-items
